alternatives.reason: The handle may be needed to turn the stars, but I would fit the lens hood first.

reason: The handle should let the star wheel turn, completing the moving sky.

effect: The handle completed the star theatre and showed that the projected image is upside down; the chapter goal is complete.
reaction: The inverted image was a surprising detail, and the drifting stars were a satisfying finish.

mostWorthwhile.text: Focusing the image on the cloth was most worthwhile: it demonstrated how sliding the lens changes where the star disc forms a sharp image.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the lens and holder was straightforward but less revealing than seeing the projection work.

surprise.text: I did not expect the projected image to be upside down.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; each part had a clear role in the projector.

continue.text: I would continue: seeing the separate constructions begin to fit Jo’s fair plan makes me curious about what they will become together.
